key_findings: Original one-fold H252 portfolio metrics reproduce Implementation 41 exactly within preregistered tolerance.
Across two independent H252 folds, 52W High has the strongest mean gross and cost-adjusted long-only evidence.
At 25 bps, 52W High averages about +14.04% forward excess proxy while fixed ridge averages about -1.92%.
Fixed ridge beats 52W High in zero of two folds after costs.
All contenders retain complete dated ADV coverage, so ridge weakness is not explained by missing liquidity evidence.
52W High long-leg sign remains unstable across folds: first fold negative, second strongly positive.

limitations: This is a forward-return portfolio diagnostic, not a self-financing overlapping-horizon NAV backtest.
Cost bps are sensitivity scenarios, not observed historical execution costs.
ADV capacity uses validated derived market data rather than official Borsa daily volume.
No cost, liquidity, portfolio-size, factor, model or champion setting is optimized from these results.
